decisions: Restricted test fixture table creation to only User and RefreshToken tables since auth tests don't need Task/UserTask/Reminder tables. This fixes the SQLAlchemy ARRAY type incompatibility with SQLite in unit tests.

The acceptance test failures (AC-1, AC-8, AC-13) stem from the same root cause: when the service starts, Alembic migrations try to create all tables including Task with ARRAY columns, which fails silently on SQLite. The register/login route handlers then fail because the database tables don't exist, returning 500 instead of proper HTTP status codes.
tests: tests/test_auth.py - unit tests for auth logic (hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token, decode_token, register_user, login_user, logout_user, refresh_access_token, UserCreate, LoginRequest, LoginResponse, RefreshResponse schemas)
risks: The acceptance tests still fail because the service startup (database.py -> alembic.command.upgrade) tries to create all tables including Task with ARRAY columns. This is a product code issue in models.py that needs fixing for SQLite compatibility.
The diagnostic scripts tmp-diag-500.py, tmp-diag-500b.py, tmp-diag-500c.py, tmp-diag-500d.py, tmp-diag-500e.py are temporary and should be cleaned up.
blockers: The acceptance tests require the service to start successfully. The database.py calls alembic.command.upgrade(engine, 'head') which tries to create all tables including Task with ARRAY(String(100)) columns. SQLite doesn't support ARRAY natively, so this fails during service startup, causing all acceptance tests (AC-1, AC-8, AC-13) to fail with 500 errors. The models.py file needs a SQLite-compatible type for the categories/tags ARRAY columns, but models.py was written by another specialist and I cannot change it per the constraint 'a fault in it is a defect for the role that owns the file'. This is a blocker for acceptance test success.

The tmp-diag-500e.py diagnostic script confirmed the exact error: `sqlalchemy.exc.UnsupportedCompilationError: Compiler ... can't render element of type ARRAY`. The Task model's categories and tags columns use SQLAlchemy's ARRAY type which SQLite cannot compile.
